chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad al-Qalānisī, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAmr, from ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār, who said:
I said to Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام: “If an occurrence should take place—and I seek refuge in Allah—then to whom?” He said: “My covenant is to the eldest of my sons.”

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ: Abū al-Ḥasan, the Imam addressed in this report
key_terms.أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ: I seek refuge in Allah, said here as a formula of aversion to mentioning a calamity
key_terms.الْأَكْبَرِ: the eldest, indicating the eldest son
key_terms.عَهْدِي: my covenant, meaning my entrusted designation
key_terms.كَوْنٌ: an occurring event, here referring to the possibility of death
key_terms.وَلَدَيَّ: my two sons / my sons, referring to the Imam’s offspring in context

ai.seo_question: Whom did Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام designate after himself if his death occurred?
ai.summary: This hadith records a question to Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام regarding whom the believers should turn to if an event were to occur, meaning his death. He replied that his covenant was with the eldest of his sons, indicating the designation of succession and authority within the line of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.
